_README: SEALED relevance labels for the M2-B2 quality gate (recommendation_core/quality.py).
Grades: 2 = highly relevant, 1 = acceptable, 0 = explicitly irrelevant.
These labels are an independent-judge draft produced outside the evaluated Qwen model.
A human second pass is required before production promotion; do not describe this draft as human-sealed.
Label against the demo catalog by running each case's query and grading the CANDIDATE
SLATE (not just what v2 showed — unlabeled shown SKUs count as NOT relevant).
split.dev cases may be inspected while tuning; split.test cases are the gate — the eval
must never train on the gate (classification_labels.json discipline).
The quality gate HONESTLY FAILS below labeled_coverage_min until this set is filled in.
'explain_followup:1') — the stateful replay measures each TURN, and a follow-up turn's
relevant set differs from turn 0's. Split entries use the same keyed form.
